entries.en: Her unfinished sketch of Anastatica lay beneath the open window when the rain began.
entries.zh: 雨下起来时，她那幅未完成的含生草属植物素描还放在开着的窗户下面。

entries.meaningZh: 伤口边缘的退缩〔医学用语〕
entries.en: The old drawing showed anastole clearly, but its explanatory notes were illegible.
entries.zh: 那幅旧图清楚地显示了伤口边缘的退缩，但说明文字无法辨认。

entries.en: The student enlarged the image of the anastral spindle before drawing its outline.
entries.zh: 学生先放大了那张无星状体纺锤体的图像，再画出它的轮廓。

entries.en: The collector wrapped the small piece of anatase before placing it in the padded box.
entries.zh: 收藏者先裹好那块小锐钛矿，再把它放进带衬垫的盒子。

entries.en: The historian questioned the account of anatherapeusis because several dosage records were missing.
entries.zh: 那位史学研究者对增剂疗法的记述提出了疑问，因为几份剂量记录缺失了。

entries.en: The museum lent us its illustrations of Anatidae for the school exhibition.
entries.zh: 博物馆把鸭科鸟类的插图借给我们，用于学校的展览。

entries.meaningZh: 引入阴离子作用〔配位化学〕
entries.en: Our discussion of anation continued over lunch after the chemistry seminar had ended.
entries.zh: 化学研讨会结束后，我们吃午饭时还在继续讨论引入阴离子作用。

entries.en: Several pages had come loose from the old anatomicomedical handbook on her desk.
entries.zh: 她桌上那本旧医用解剖学手册有几页散了。

entries.en: He rewrote the introduction to his anatomicophysiological study after receiving the editor's comments.
entries.zh: 收到编辑的意见后，他重写了那项解剖生理学研究的引言。

entries.en: The historian found an early report on anatoxic immunization among the donated papers.
entries.zh: 那位史学研究者在捐赠的文献中发现了一份关于类毒素免疫的早期报告。

entries.meaningZh: 升线三波脉的〔旧医学术语〕
entries.en: She requested a clearer copy of the anatricrotic tracing in the old physiology volume.
entries.zh: 她请求提供那本旧生理学书中升线三波脉图的更清晰副本。

entries.meaningZh: 升线三波脉现象〔旧医学术语〕
entries.en: The lecturer paused during the discussion of anatricrotism to replace the damaged slide.
entries.zh: 讲者在讨论升线三波脉现象时停了下来，更换那张损坏的幻灯片。

entries.en: The faded diagram of anatropia became clearer when the conservator removed its stained protective sheet.
entries.zh: 文物修复师移去那张有污渍的保护纸后，褪色的上隐斜眼示意图变得清晰了些。

entries.meaningZh: 胭脂树果实制成的黄红色染料〔annatto的异体〕
entries.en: A faded cloth sample lay beside the jar of anatto in the textile collection.
entries.zh: 纺织品藏品中，一块褪色的布样放在那罐胭脂树果实染料旁边。

entries.en: The museum assistant photographed the old anauxite specimen before repairing its cracked display case.
entries.zh: 博物馆助理先拍摄了那件旧蠕陶土标本，再修理开裂的陈列柜。

entries.meaningZh: 安纳沃尔聚酯纤维〔旧商品名〕
entries.en: The costume designer chose the surviving Anavor swatch for the exhibition's textile panel.
entries.zh: 服装设计师为展览的纺织品展板选了那块保存下来的安纳沃尔聚酯纤维布样。

entries.en: A dark stain obscured the anaxon near the centre of the student's drawing.
entries.zh: 一块深色污渍遮住了学生图画中央附近的那个无轴索细胞。

entries.en: She left room beside the enlarged anaxone for a second drawing at a smaller scale.
entries.zh: 她在放大的无轴索细胞图旁留了位置，准备再画一幅比例更小的图。

entries.meaningZh: 阿纳约丁；喹碘方〔旧名称〕
entries.en: The chemist could not compare the anayodin samples until the missing notebook arrived.
entries.zh: 那本丢失的笔记本送来之前，化学家无法比较那些阿纳约丁样品。

entries.en: The old report contrasted anazotic materials with those containing nitrogen, but omitted the measurements.
entries.zh: 那份旧报告对比了无氮材料与含氮材料，却没有列出测量数据。

entries.en: The discussion of anazoturia ended before anyone explained the gaps in the old records.
entries.zh: 有关缺氮尿的讨论结束时，仍没有人解释那些旧记录中的空缺。

entries.en: Questions about Ancalomicrobium kept the visiting researcher busy after her lecture.
entries.zh: 讲座结束后，来访研究员仍忙着回答有关臂微细菌属的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 阳极通电收缩〔旧医学缩写〕
entries.en: The historian compared two early records of AnCC while preparing the physiology exhibition.
entries.zh: 筹备生理学展览时，那位史学研究者比较了两份早期的阳极通电收缩记录。

entries.en: A damaged illustration of anchilops occupied most of the page in the old casebook.
entries.zh: 那本旧病例集的一页上，大部分篇幅是一幅受损的内眦脓肿插图。

entries.en: The archivist found a damaged study of anchusin among the chemist's personal papers.
entries.zh: 档案员在那位化学家的私人文献中发现了一篇受损的紫草素研究。

entries.en: The two accounts of anchylops disagreed about when the swelling had first appeared.
entries.zh: 那两份内眦脓肿记述，对肿胀最初出现的时间说法不一致。

entries.en: The illustrator borrowed an old monograph on Ancistrodon to check the damaged snake drawing.
entries.zh: 插画师借来一本关于蝮属蛇的旧专著，核对那幅受损的蛇图。

entries.en: The sculptor exaggerated the creature's ancistroid claws in the final model.
entries.zh: 雕塑家在最终模型中夸张地表现了那只生物钩样的爪子。

entries.en: The old ancistrum remained in its display case while the other instruments were photographed.
entries.zh: 拍摄其他器械时，那把旧外科钩仍留在陈列柜中。

entries.en: The final page of the report on ancitabine was missing from the archive copy.
entries.zh: 档案馆那份关于安西他滨的报告副本缺了最后一页。

entries.en: The old anatomical plate showed the ancon clearly despite a stain along its edge.
entries.zh: 那张旧解剖图版的边缘虽有污渍，肘部仍显示得很清楚。

entries.en: The old account of anconagra described discomfort during even simple household tasks.
entries.zh: 那份关于肘痛风症的旧记述，描述了连做简单家务时也会有的不适。

entries.en: The illustrator left the anconal region unfinished when the studio lights failed.
entries.zh: 工作室的灯坏了，插画师还没画完肘部区域。

entries.en: A crease ran through the anconeal region of the old anatomical drawing.
entries.zh: 那幅旧解剖图上的一道折痕穿过了肘部区域。

entries.en: She compared two drawings of the anconeus before completing her anatomical model.
entries.zh: 她完成解剖模型之前，比较了两幅肘肌的图画。

entries.en: His account of anconitis mentioned difficulty lifting a cup, but gave no explanation of its cause.
entries.zh: 他对肘关节炎的记述提到端杯子有困难，却没有解释病因。

entries.en: The curved metal fitting had an anconoid shape that complicated the packing.
entries.zh: 那个弯曲的金属配件呈肘样形状，包装起来很不方便。

entries.en: A small collection of Ancylidae occupied the lower shelf of the cabinet.
entries.zh: 一小批淡水笠螺科藏品摆在柜子的下层架子上。

entries.en: The paleontologist compared two old reconstructions of Ancylopoda before ordering a new display model.
entries.zh: 古生物学家比较了两个爪兽亚目的旧复原模型，才订购新的展示模型。

entries.en: The library's oldest illustrated volume on Ancylostoma was unavailable during the restoration work.
entries.zh: 修复期间，图书馆那本最老的钩口线虫属图册无法借阅。

entries.en: The editor moved the discussion of ancylostomatic infection to an earlier chapter.
entries.zh: 编辑把有关钩虫感染的讨论移到了前面的一章。

entries.en: She borrowed a larger magnifier to examine the old illustrations of Ancylostomatidae.
entries.zh: 她借来一把更大的放大镜，观察那些钩口科的旧插图。

entries.en: Her drawings of Ancylostomidae were ready before the museum found space to display them.
entries.zh: 博物馆还没找到展示位置，她就已经画好了那些钩口线虫科图画。

entries.en: The museum's specimen of Ancylus was accidentally photographed beside the wrong ruler.
entries.zh: 拍摄博物馆那件曲螺属标本时，不小心在旁边放错了标尺。

entries.en: The torn cover of the ancymidol report had been repaired with yellowing tape.
entries.zh: 那份嘧啶醇报告破损的封面，用泛黄的胶带修补过。

entries.en: The conservator traced the ancyroid outline of the clasp onto thin paper.
entries.zh: 文物修复师把那枚扣子钩样的轮廓描在薄纸上。

entries.en: An illustration of Anda had been cut from the damaged botanical album.
entries.zh: 那本受损的植物画册中，一幅安达树属植物插图被剪走了。

entries.en: A visitor asked permission to sketch the andalusite specimen after the museum had closed.
entries.zh: 博物馆闭馆后，一位访客请求获准给那件红柱石标本画素描。

entries.en: Her study of Andamanese music was interrupted by the loss of several recordings.
entries.zh: 几份录音的丢失，打断了她对安达曼人音乐的研究。

entries.en: The historian requested a sharper photograph of the andere container in the collection.
entries.zh: 那位史学研究者请求提供藏品中那个盐酸丁二胍容器的更清晰照片。

entries.en: A postcard from Anderlecht fell out of the book she had borrowed.
entries.zh: 一张来自安德莱赫特的明信片，从她借来的书里掉了出来。

entries.en: The mineral collector left the andesine under glass while she rearranged the display.
entries.zh: 那位矿物收藏者重新布置陈列时，把中长石留在了玻璃罩下。

entries.meaningZh: 进行“与”运算〔计算机用语〕
entries.en: The programmer was ANDing two masks when the demonstration laptop froze.
entries.zh: 程序员正在对两个掩码进行“与”运算，演示用的笔记本电脑就死机了。

entries.en: The old botanical album contained a watercolour of Andira with an unfinished background.
entries.zh: 那本旧植物画册中，有一幅背景尚未画完的柯桠树属植物水彩画。

entries.en: We found the missing correspondence about andirine in a box of the chemist's drafts.
entries.zh: 我们在一箱化学家的草稿中，找到了那些丢失的有关柯桠树碱的信件。

entries.en: Her photograph of Andizhan was too creased to mount without damaging it further.
entries.zh: 她那张安集延的照片折痕太重，装裱时难免进一步损坏。

entries.en: The student spent her last afternoon at the museum drawing the andorite specimen.
entries.zh: 学生在博物馆度过的最后一个下午，一直在画那件硫锑铅银矿标本。

entries.en: The museum displayed several worn instruments beside the nineteenth-century manual of andranatomy.
entries.zh: 博物馆在那本十九世纪男体解剖手册旁，陈列了几件磨损的器械。

entries.en: The botanist's photographs of Andreaea were still drying when the visitors arrived.
entries.zh: 访客到来时，植物学家拍摄的黑藓属植物照片还没晾干。

entries.en: A discussion of Andreaeales continued outside after the seminar room had been locked.
entries.zh: 研讨室锁门后，有关黑藓目的讨论还在外面继续。

entries.en: The old monograph on Andreaeobrya had lost its binding but retained all its illustrations.
entries.zh: 那本关于黑藓亚纲的旧专著已经脱了装订，但插图全都还在。

entries.meaningZh: 卵巢男性细胞瘤〔旧名称〕
entries.en: The old report on andreioma referred to a drawing that the archive no longer held.
entries.zh: 那份关于卵巢男性细胞瘤的旧报告，提到了一幅档案馆已不再保存的图画。

entries.en: The illustrator requested another photograph of Andrenidae because the first lacked a scale.
entries.zh: 第一张照片没有标尺，插画师于是请求再提供一张地花蜂科的照片。

entries.en: The editor returned the article on andrenosterone with several handwritten questions in the margin.
entries.zh: 编辑退回了那篇肾上腺甾酮文章，页边写着几个手写的问题。

entries.en: Her borrowed novel by Andric contained a train ticket between its final pages.
entries.zh: 她借来的那本安德里奇小说，最后几页之间夹着一张火车票。

entries.en: A visitor knocked over the magnifier while examining the museum's Andricus specimens.
entries.zh: 一位访客观察博物馆的安堆瘿蜂属标本时，碰倒了放大镜。

entries.en: The seminar on androblastoma was postponed when the visiting pathologist missed her train.
entries.zh: 来访的病理学家没赶上火车，有关卵巢男性细胞瘤的研讨会因此推迟了。

entries.meaningZh: 安德鲁克里斯〔罗马传说人物〕
entries.en: The child playing Androcles wanted to rehearse beside the large wooden lion.
entries.zh: 那个扮演安德鲁克里斯的孩子，想在大木狮子旁排练。

entries.meaningZh: 雄花两性花异株的〔植物学〕
entries.en: Her sketches of the androdioecious plants were ready, but the exhibition space was not.
entries.zh: 她画的那些雄花两性花异株植物素描已经准备好了，展览场地却还没准备好。

entries.meaningZh: 雄花两性花异株现象〔植物学〕
entries.en: The botanist postponed her talk on androdioecism after losing her field notebook.
entries.zh: 植物学家丢失野外笔记本后，推迟了有关雄花两性花异株现象的讲座。

entries.meaningZh: 雄性交配素〔生物学用语〕
entries.en: The researcher's notes on androgamone were scattered across three notebooks with missing covers.
entries.zh: 研究员关于雄性交配素的笔记，散记在三本封面缺失的笔记本中。

entries.en: The student redrew the androgone after noticing that her first sketch was badly proportioned.
entries.zh: 学生发现第一幅素描比例严重失调后，重新画了那个精原细胞。

entries.en: Two labels on the container of andrographolide had become illegible during the move.
entries.zh: 搬运过程中，那只穿心莲内酯容器上的两张标签变得无法辨认了。

entries.en: The zoologist redrew the diagrams for her discussion of androgynism after reviewing the specimens.
entries.zh: 动物学家重新查看标本后，重画了用于讨论雌雄同体的示意图。

entries.meaningZh: 卵巢男性细胞瘤〔旧名称〕
entries.en: The historian found conflicting dates in two handwritten accounts of androma.
entries.zh: 那位史学研究者在两份卵巢男性细胞瘤手写记述中，发现了互相矛盾的日期。

entries.meaningZh: 安德洛玛刻〔希腊神话人物〕
entries.en: The actress playing Andromache could not find her cloak before the rehearsal.
entries.zh: 扮演安德洛玛刻的女演员在排练前找不到自己的斗篷了。

entries.en: The librarian located an early study of andromedotoxin in the uncatalogued collection.
entries.zh: 图书馆员在尚未编目的藏书中找到了一篇有关马醉木毒素的早期研究。

entries.meaningZh: 具有雄性激素样作用的〔生理学用语〕
entries.en: The editor requested clearer illustrations for the chapter on andromimetic effects.
entries.zh: 编辑要求为讨论雄性激素样作用的那一章提供更清晰的插图。

entries.meaningZh: 雄花两性花同株的〔植物学〕
entries.en: An andromonoecious plant had grown through the greenhouse's broken ventilation grille.
entries.zh: 一株雄花两性花同株的植物，从温室破损的通风格栅中长了出来。

entries.meaningZh: 雄花两性花同株现象〔植物学〕
entries.en: Her lecture on andromonoecism ended with a long discussion of the illustrations.
entries.zh: 她关于雄花两性花同株现象的讲座，以一场围绕插图的长时间讨论结束。

entries.en: The andromorphous figure in the old anatomical illustration had been partly obscured by water damage.
entries.zh: 那幅旧解剖插图中呈男性形态的人物，有一部分被水渍遮住了。

entries.en: The lectures on andropathy attracted historians as well as medical students.
entries.zh: 那些关于男性病的讲座，既吸引了医学生，也吸引了史学研究者。

entries.en: The model's androphore broke when the box slipped from the illustrator's hands.
entries.zh: 盒子从插画师手中滑落时，模型的雄蕊柄断了。

entries.en: We stopped beside the Andropogon while the gardener went back for her keys.
entries.zh: 园丁回去拿钥匙时，我们在那株须芒草属植物旁停了下来。

entries.en: The map of the Androscoggin was too wide for the exhibition's narrow display board.
entries.zh: 那张安德罗斯科金河地图太宽，展览的窄展示板放不下。

entries.en: A missing page interrupted the chemist's discussion of androsin in the handwritten manuscript.
entries.zh: 那份手稿缺了一页，打断了化学家关于草夹竹桃苷的论述。

entries.en: The illustrator enlarged the androspore so that its outline would remain visible in the small textbook.
entries.zh: 插画师把产雄器孢子画得更大，好让它的轮廓在那本小开本教科书中仍能看清。

entries.en: A smudge obscured the main peak in the printed chromatogram of androstanediol.
entries.zh: 打印出来的雄甾烷二醇色谱图上，一块污迹遮住了主峰。

entries.en: She retrieved the forgotten androstanol sample before the laboratory closed for renovation.
entries.zh: 实验室关闭装修前，她取回了那份被遗忘的雄甾烷醇样品。

entries.en: The report on androstanolone arrived without the photographs mentioned in its appendix.
entries.zh: 那份雄甾烷醇酮报告送来时，没有附上附录中提到的照片。

entries.en: The historian found several early letters about androstene beneath a damaged notebook.
entries.zh: 那位史学研究者在一本受损的笔记本下面，发现了几封早期谈论雄甾烯的信。

entries.en: The seminar on androstenediol moved upstairs after the projector failed.
entries.zh: 投影仪坏了，有关雄甾烯二醇的研讨会于是转移到了楼上。

entries.en: She repaired the binding of the old volume before scanning its article on androstenone.
entries.zh: 她先修好了那本旧书的装订，再扫描其中关于雄甾烯酮的文章。

entries.meaningZh: 衣藻定雄性素〔旧藻类生理学术语〕
entries.en: The historian questioned the early account of androtermone after comparing the surviving research notes.
entries.zh: 那位史学研究者比较了保存下来的研究笔记后，对早期关于衣藻定雄性素的记述提出了疑问。

entries.meaningZh: 缩脉管性菌毒素〔旧医学术语〕
entries.en: The damaged manuscript contained a detailed discussion of anectasin but no surviving illustrations.
entries.zh: 那份受损手稿中有对缩脉管性菌毒素的详细讨论，但插图都没保存下来。

entries.meaningZh: 琥珀酰胆碱制剂〔商品名〕
entries.en: A photograph of an Anectine vial was removed from the exhibition catalogue at the last minute.
entries.zh: 一张 Anectine 品牌琥珀酰胆碱制剂药瓶的照片，在最后一刻从展览图录中撤下了。

entries.en: The missing wire beside the anelectrode made the old apparatus difficult to interpret.
entries.zh: 阳电极旁的一根导线不见了，使那台旧仪器难以理解。

entries.meaningZh: 阳极电紧张的〔生理学用语〕
entries.en: The lecturer compared the two anelectrotonic responses without discussing the damaged apparatus.
entries.zh: 讲者比较了那两种阳极电紧张反应，没有讨论那台受损的仪器。

entries.meaningZh: 阳极电紧张〔生理学用语〕
entries.en: The students struggled to follow the explanation of anelectrotonus without the missing diagram.
entries.zh: 缺了那张示意图，学生们很难听懂对阳极电紧张的解释。

entries.en: The museum kept its old illustrations of Anelytropsidae in a flat drawer beneath the reptile display.
entries.zh: 博物馆把那些无鞘蜥科旧插图，保存在爬行动物展柜下的一个扁抽屉里。

entries.en: The botanist examined anemarrhena specimens collected near the mountain village.
entries.zh: 植物学家检查了在山村附近采集的知母属植物标本。

entries.en: The case history describes anematopoiesis but does not identify its cause.
entries.zh: 这份病史记载了造血机能不足的情况，但没有确定其原因。

entries.en: The laboratory compared anemonin samples from two separately numbered collections.
entries.zh: 实验室比较了来自两个分别编号的藏品系列的白头翁素样品。

entries.en: Her research on anemonism began with a collection of nineteenth-century case notes.
entries.zh: 她对白头翁中毒的研究始于一批十九世纪的病例笔记。

entries.en: A sealed vial of anemonol stood beside the botanist's handwritten inventory.
entries.zh: 一小瓶密封的白头翁脑放在植物学家的手写清单旁。

entries.en: His anemophobia made the prospect of a windy coastal holiday distressing.
entries.zh: 由于畏风，想到要去多风的海滨度假，他就感到苦恼。

entries.en: The students considered whether anemotaxis could explain the direction of movement.
entries.zh: 学生们思考，向风性能否解释这种运动的方向。

entries.en: She questioned whether the observed response was anemotropism or simply physical displacement.
entries.zh: 她质疑，观察到的反应究竟是趋风性，还是仅仅是物体位置的移动。

entries.en: The historical atlas places two illustrations of anencephalotrophia on facing pages.
entries.zh: 这本历史图谱将两幅脑萎缩插图放在相对的两页上。

entries.en: An anatomical drawing of an anencephalus accompanied the old case description.
entries.zh: 那份旧病例说明附有一幅无脑畸胎的解剖图。

entries.en: The diary describes anenergia that made even short walks seem exhausting.
entries.zh: 日记记述了一种精力不足的状态，连走一小段路都令人觉得疲惫。

entries.en: The discussion of anenteremia focuses on the intestinal blood supply.
entries.zh: 关于肠内血液不足的讨论重点涉及肠道的血液供应。

entries.en: The old clinical account distinguishes anenteroneuria from a mechanical blockage.
entries.zh: 那份旧临床记录区分了肠无力与机械性梗阻。

entries.en: The chapter on anenterotrophy includes drawings of the affected intestine.
entries.zh: 关于肠萎缩的那一章包含受影响肠道的绘图。

entries.en: The anenterous specimen was drawn without an intestinal tract.
entries.zh: 这幅无肠标本的图中没有画出肠道。

entries.en: The archivist found anenzymia among the diagnoses recorded in the old ledger.
entries.zh: 档案管理员在旧登记簿记载的诊断中发现了无酶症。

entries.en: The anatomical model illustrating anephrogenesis had no kidneys.
entries.zh: 展示无肾畸形的解剖模型没有肾脏。

entries.en: The case notes describe anepia without explaining how speech was assessed.
entries.zh: 病例笔记记载了失语，却没有说明如何评估言语能力。

entries.en: The anepiploic specimen appeared in a separate anatomical illustration.
entries.zh: 这份无网膜标本出现在另一幅解剖插图中。

entries.en: The historical account describes anergasia through the patient's profound lack of activity.
entries.zh: 这份历史记录通过患者活动能力严重缺乏的情况描述了活动力缺失。

entries.en: Her account of anergia emphasizes how difficult ordinary household tasks had become.
entries.zh: 她对无力状态的叙述着重说明了日常家务变得多么困难。

entries.en: The anergic patient found the walk from the bedroom exhausting.
entries.zh: 这位无力的患者觉得从卧室走出来就很累。

entries.en: The designer avoided relying on red alone when considering readers with anerythroblepsia.
entries.zh: 考虑到红色盲读者，设计师避免仅靠红色传递信息。

entries.en: Different shapes made the chart easier to use for someone with anerythrochloropsia.
entries.zh: 不同的形状使红绿色盲人士更容易使用这张图表。

entries.en: The illustrated anerythrocyte was uncoloured, unlike the surrounding red cells.
entries.zh: 图中那枚无色红细胞没有着色，与周围的红细胞不同。

entries.en: The old case description identifies anerythroplasia as a failure of red-cell formation.
entries.zh: 那份旧病例说明将红细胞发生不能描述为无法形成红细胞。

entries.en: The anerythroplastic condition was discussed in the section on red-cell formation.
entries.zh: 红细胞发生不能的这种情况在关于红细胞形成的章节中得到了讨论。

entries.en: The historical report discusses anerythropoiesis alongside observations of reduced red-cell production.
entries.zh: 这份历史报告在讨论红细胞生成不足的同时，记述了红细胞产生减少的观察结果。

entries.en: He chose patterns rather than red shading to accommodate readers with anerythropsia.
entries.zh: 为方便红色盲读者，他选用了图案而非红色阴影。

entries.en: The anerythroregenerative state was described as a failure to regenerate red cells.
entries.zh: 这种红细胞再生不能的状态被描述为无法再生红细胞。

entries.en: The patient welcomed the brief anesis after a night of discomfort.
entries.zh: 一夜难受过后，患者对这短暂的缓解感到欣慰。

entries.en: The old case record describes anesthecinesia affecting both sensation and movement.
entries.zh: 那份旧病例记录描述了感觉与运动能力同时缺失的情况。

entries.en: The account of anesthekinesia records the loss of movement as well as sensation.
entries.zh: 这份关于感觉与运动能力缺失的记录记述了运动能力和感觉的丧失。

entries.en: The museum's anesthesimeter was displayed with other instruments for assessing sensation.
entries.zh: 博物馆的感觉缺失测量器与其他评估感觉的仪器一同展出。

entries.en: The researcher compared the anesthesin chromatogram with a reference chromatogram.
entries.zh: 研究人员将苯佐卡因的色谱图与参照色谱图进行了比较。

entries.en: The surgical record gives the time of anesthetization separately from the operation's starting time.
entries.zh: 手术记录将麻醉时间与手术开始时间分别列出。

entries.en: The anesthetizer introduced herself before the patient entered the operating room.
entries.zh: 患者进入手术室前，麻醉师作了自我介绍。

entries.en: The technician checked the anesthetometer against the original instrument diagram.
entries.zh: 技术人员对照原始仪器图纸检查了麻醉气计量器。

entries.en: The old surgical record notes anesthetospasm during the period of anesthesia.
entries.zh: 那份旧手术记录记载了麻醉期间出现的痉挛。

entries.en: The curator photographed the anethene container before moving the chemical collection.
entries.zh: 馆员在搬动化学品藏品之前，拍下了莳萝烃容器的照片。

entries.en: The chromatogram showed an anethole peak beside several smaller peaks.
entries.zh: 色谱图上有一个茴香脑峰，旁边还有几个较小的峰。

entries.en: The artist drew Anethum specimens for the botanical exhibition.
entries.zh: 画家为植物展绘制了莳萝属植物的标本图。

entries.en: The anetiological classification grouped cases by symptoms rather than their causes.
entries.zh: 这种非病原学的分类按照症状而非病因对病例进行分组。
